graph_decision.evidence: J1 (index 525) shows an abrupt upward step in all three axes (N, E, U) in the original displacement; J2 (index 587) shows a matching abrupt downward step returning each axis near its pre-J1 level. The slow-trajectory-subtracted plots confirm that the offsets at J1 and J2 are isolated spikes with no sustained trend change between them—consistent with a transient platform. No other persistent steps remain after subtraction, and the trajectory resumes its prior trend post-J2. Thus, P1 is valid and no standalone steps are needed.
